quest.title: A Cloud-Sea Appeal, a Brilliance Revealed
quest.description: In order to thank you for your help, Gaming proposes to invite you to Xinyue Kiosk for some dim sum...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x6

chapter.num: Vibrant Harriers Aloft in Spring Breeze: Part II
chapter.title: A Cloud-Sea Appeal, a Brilliance Revealed

talks.objective: Wait until the appointed time (08:00 – 12:00 two days later)
Go to Xinyue Kiosk and have dim sum with Gaming

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Oh! You're here early. I just ordered. The food should be out in a second. Sit down, sit down.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's all take a seat.

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Here, hand me your cups.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, thank you!

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Wait! You weren't supposed to drink that, Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: That was for you to rinse your utensils.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? That's a thing?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: As you talk, piping hot dim sum dishes arrive at the table one after another.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: And just when you think that all the dishes have been delivered, the hostess brings over a generous bowl of seafood congee...

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Ganyu, Ganyu! C'mon, wake up! Some friends have arrived!

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Hello... friends...

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Ganyuuu!

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: I have some mint oil. Perhaps we should try that?

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: A guest at Wanmin Restaurant recommended it to me. I've tried it. Its stimulative effects are much stronger than what can be achieved from chewing on mint leaves alone.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: *snore* *snore*

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: *sigh*

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: ...Apologies in advance.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Wait! Shenhe! Not there...!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You see Shenhe take out a small green bottle, extract some minty-smelling liquid, and apply it to Ganyu's horns.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Yaoyao and Paimon look on in shock, mouths agape, but cannot stop her in time...

talks.objective: Check on how construction is going

dialogues.speaker: Shuyu
dialogues.text: Hey Gaming, want to team up?

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Huh? I have to participate? I thought I'd be done for the day after adjusting the dye formula.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You're that unenthused by kite-making, huh? That doesn't seem like you.

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: No, it's not that. It's just...

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: *sigh* It would take too long to explain. I guess I'll just make one then.

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: What shape should we go with... How about a butterfly?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (The butterfly symbolizes the desire for freedom. Perhaps that's also what Gaming's searching for.)

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: What do you think, Shuyu? Is there a particular design you want?

dialogues.speaker: Shuyu
dialogues.text: I want a suanni!

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: That might be a little hard to pull off...

dialogues.speaker: Shuyu
dialogues.text: True, but I still want to try! They're super cute!

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Okay! It's decided, then!

talks.objective: Check on how construction is going

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Um, Shenhe... It would be great if you could refrain from putting things on my horns from now on. They're really quite sensitive...

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: I see. My apologies. I shall remember that in the future.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Thank you. No harm done.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Good.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: ...Could I touch them just once more though? No oil or anything this time. I've just always wondered what Ms. Ganyu's horns feel like.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Huh? Please, I told you, just call me "Ganyu"... *sigh* Well, alright... Just be gentle.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: (Firm to the touch with no discernable temperature, not unlike certain medicinal plants I've eaten before.)

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: (Still, Ganyu appears to be shaking like a cat whose whiskers have just been touched... I should stop.)

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Ugh...

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: ...I see.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Then I'll apply the oil to your forehead next time.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Oh, no need, I'll just... refrain from taking afternoon naps outdoors.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: *cough* *cough*... Anyway, we should probably get started on our kite. It won't be long before Cloud Retainer comes to check on our progress.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Perhaps... Perhaps we should just choose the most traditional style.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Okay.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, they seem to be getting along swimmingly. Let's not disturb them.

talks.objective: Check on how construction is going

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Aunty Cloud Retainer, look! Am I doing it right?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Very good. Your frame is nice and sturdy. This design... Is it a finch?

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Yep! ♪ *whistle*~ ♪

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Hehe... One is looking forward to seeing your finished product.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What color are you going to make it, Yaoyao?

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: I haven't decided yet. If I make it blue, it'll be more like my friend. But if I make it gold, it'll be more like me.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: If you are asking for one's own opinion... One would advise choosing gold.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: When giving a gift, the key consideration is the recipient's feelings, is it not? One imagines your friend would much prefer a kite that reminds them of you.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Hey, I never told you the kite was for Qiqi... How did you know?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: With age comes wisdom, child. One simply has a way of knowing things.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Cool! Thanks, Aunty Cloud Retainer!

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: I'm gonna start painting it gold right now!

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Good. One will watch.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: You two seem strangely unoccupied. One was under the impression that one was supposed to be doing the relaxing. Is your kite finished?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: W—We actually haven't started yet. But we're going to start... right now!

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: The scissor-tailed swallow sure takes a lot of curved bamboo rods to build...

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Ah...

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: It broke.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yep, that's the one.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Now that we've decided, let's make it happen.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Is that... the Jade Chamber?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Oh?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: As a gentle breeze brushes past, the "Jade Chamber" drifts towards everyone's feet...

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Who dares attempt such a flagrant display of impropriety by releasing a kite into one's territory without one's permission...

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: And to do so by making use of this... crude piece of mortal machinery!

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: One simply must know who it is that possesses such impertinence!

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Continue attaching the strings, everyone. One will be but a moment.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Cloud Retainer...!

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, could I trouble you to go after Cloud Retainer?

dialogues.speaker: Shuyu
dialogues.text: Master is going to be okay, right?

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: I'm... more worried about the person who released the kite.

talks.objective: Follow Xianyun and check out the situation

dialogues.speaker: Houzhang
dialogues.text: Hmm. This Fontainian device of mechanical motion is quite curious indeed...

dialogues.speaker: Jiehu
dialogues.text: Now is hardly an opportune time for your musings! Someone among us was not sufficiently attentive, and now the kite has vanished!

dialogues.speaker: Houzhang
dialogues.text: Calm yourself. Do you have any recollection of its last location?

dialogues.speaker: Jiehu
dialogues.text: One believes it drifted in the direction of Mt. Aocang.

dialogues.speaker: Jiehu
dialogues.text: Perhaps it is mere happenstance, but one feels a certain sense of dread at the thought.

dialogues.speaker: Houzhang
dialogues.text: Your concern is misplaced, surely.

dialogues.speaker: Houzhang
dialogues.text: Cloud Retainer is either in the city looking after her disciples or secluded in her abode attending to her research. She will not notice that kite.

dialogues.speaker: Houzhang
dialogues.text: On the subject of said kite, however, one simply must remark on the genius of its windless lift technology. One cannot help but surmise that its ingenuity rivals that of Cloud Retainer's creations...

dialogues.speaker: Jiehu
dialogues.text: Still thy tongue! If Cloud Retainer were to hear you profess such a thing, we can both say farewell to any further use of the Supreme Cuisine Machine!

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: One presumes... that this kite belongs to you?

dialogues.speaker: Jiehu
dialogues.text: (Regard the situation with which we are now confronted! This is all your fault!)

dialogues.speaker: Houzhang
dialogues.text: (One's fault? One seems to recall that releasing the kite was no solitary endeavor.)

dialogues.speaker: Houzhang
dialogues.text: (Say something, Mountain Shaper. Surely you can think of something to appease her!)

dialogues.speaker: Jiehu
dialogues.text: (Further explanation shall only fan the flames of her wrath. It would be better to stay silent and retire at the earliest opportunity!)

dialogues.speaker: Houzhang
dialogues.text: (We can hardly avoid her forever. That may suffice during Lantern Rite, but what about the Moonchase Festival? Sooner or later, she will discover our true identity.)

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: ...Hello?

dialogues.speaker: Jiehu
dialogues.text: (Go retrieve the kite.)

dialogues.speaker: Houzhang
dialogues.text: (Absolutely not. You retrieve it!)

dialogues.speaker: Jiehu
dialogues.text: That... is not our kite...

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Oh? So, an adeptus such as oneself is mistaken then?

dialogues.speaker: Houzhang
dialogues.text: Ah! You're an adeptus? Please forgive us for any impropriety.

dialogues.speaker: Houzhang
dialogues.text: I truly possess no inkling of who could have released a kite into your esteemed demesne. Pray, who could be responsible for such wanton behavior...

dialogues.speaker: Jiehu
dialogues.text: Verily! Verily! We were but delighting in the surrounding scenery. This locale is home to such exquisite...erm... Ah! Mint!

dialogues.speaker: Jiehu
dialogues.text: Well, and if that's all, then we'll just be on our way...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Phew... we finally caught up. You sure do fly fast in your illuminated bird form, Xianyun!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Moon Carver? Mountain Shaper? What are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: She...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, now Paimon's getting a weird vibe. Did she say something wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: It is of no consequence. Long has one seen through their disguises. One was simply curious as to how long they would keep up the act.

dialogues.speaker: Houzhang
dialogues.text: Then, you are not angry?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Hmph. How could one feel anger at the sight of two old friends enjoying themselves? One is also well aware of how enticing these city novelties can be.

dialogues.speaker: Jiehu
dialogues.text: *sigh* We were simply consumed by a fit of festive spirit. Seldom do we get the opportunity to partake in the delights of the times.

dialogues.speaker: Jiehu
dialogues.text: However, we are far from being as adept as you in matters that require a deftness of hand. No worthy kite could be born of our own making. Thus, we could only take the convenient route, so to speak.

dialogues.speaker: Houzhang
dialogues.text: Your prowess in mechanics is unparalleled, Cloud Retainer. You wield the wind and waves themselves. Your singular talent stands unmatched across the land... Of this we are well aware.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Hmph...

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: One has guests to attend to. We will have to convene again some other time.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, do try to keep up.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're leaving already? Argh, all this flying from place to place is wearing Paimon out!

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: They're back.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's pooped. Huh? Why are there only two of you left?

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: After you left, Yaoyao and Shuyu tired themselves out playing with their kites.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Gaming offered to escort them home.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Before he left, he said something that I don't quite understand.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh? What did he say?

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: He said, "A kite is always tied down no matter how far it flies or how high it soars. Its tether prevents it from ever truly flying free."

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: He looked quite dejected as he said this.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Now that you mention it, Gaming did seem to have a rather strange attitude towards kites.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Perhaps he sees himself reflected in them?

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: A reflection of himself...

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: If I were a kite, I would cherish that tether as a symbol of kinship and the bonds that tie us, and...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Shenhe?

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: It may be an exceedingly slim and distant connection, but lose it, and you lose that which links you to home.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: If Gaming truly sees a kite as a reflection of himself... Then I fear I understand his words even less.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Well, people often have different points of view depending on their mindset and experiences, right? It's actually quite normal.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: ...Just like some people can eat spicy food, but others won't go anywhere near it?

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Exactly. That's why tolerance and understanding are as important as they are.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Tolerance and understanding? What brought about this conversation? Did one miss something?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We were just chatting — you don't have to butt in on every little thing, you know. Where were you, anyway?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Hmph, one was merely doing a bit of cooking.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Night fast approaches. If you are otherwise unoccupied, one would entreat you to stay and eat before you depart.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Oh! It's been so long since I've had the chance to enjoy your cooking, Cloud Retainer!

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Worry not. One has prepared a variety of meat and vegetable dishes. One is more than familiar with everyone's culinary proclivities.

choices.text: We'll take you up on your offer then.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Shenhe, Ganyu, come with me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Woah, what's with all the secrecy? You're not trying to play favorites, are you?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If you're ready to serve the food, we can help too!

choices.text: I call dibs on Paimon's portion.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! Paimon's hungry too! It's not like the dim sum and grilled fish could keep her full the whole day, y'know!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You wait outside Cloud Retainer's abode for a few moments...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Th—This is...!

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: (Ohh... I can feel the wind brushing against my legs. This is a bit embarrassing...)

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: (Is the headpiece secure? I should have asked Cloud Retainer to check before I stepped outside...)

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: How do we look?

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: (Huh!? She asked them just like that...?)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You look great.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You look pretty too, Ganyu. How should Paimon put it? You both look so elegant and refined — those outfits really suit you both.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Given that one employed the services of the best tailor in all of Liyue, one would expect nothing less.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: What colors have you been partial to lately, Shenhe and Ganyu?

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: (Lately? Why is Cloud Retainer suddenly asking about what colors we like?)

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: I like black.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: One is gratified to see that one's disciple has inherited one's own tastes.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: (The color black doesn't get dirty easily — a virtue I've come to value recently.)

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: And you, Ganyu?

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: I favor blue and black.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: And the material is sufficiently comfortable, yes?

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Yes, very. I simply cannot thank you enough, Cloud Retainer — for this gift, and the kite, too.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Thank you, Master.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: One is content as long as you are pleased with the gift. One hopes these garments will see much use.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You sit down and enjoy a tableful of delicious food and pleasant company...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Seems like your Supreme Cuisine Machine is just getting better and better, Xianyun!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This Golden Crab's particularly good. The shell's deliciously crunchy, and the meat inside is so succulent and sweet. Hehe, Paimon can't stop eating!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's a good thing Gaming isn't here or Paimon would have to have to duel him for the food — y'know, with chopsticks!

choices.text: It would be a close match.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: He traveled all this way on account of the kite-making workshop, and he spent the whole afternoon looking after Shuyu... One was hoping to treat him to a meal.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Oh well... One will just have to extend one's thanks in person.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: It's rare for someone to make such a good impression on you, Cloud Retainer.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Hah. One has high standards.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: He appears to be a young man of much merit, and one is not the type who would see such potential squandered.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: It appears that he wishes to break free from the kite string that tethers him.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Kite string? What strange metaphors you speak in, Shenhe. Ever since you returned from Wanmin Restaurant, your turns of phrase render one at quite the loss.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Where do we even begin... Oh, do you know about the conflict between Gaming and his dad, Xianyun?

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: One has only heard that the two are not on good terms...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: He ran away from home and hasn't been back since!

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: Oh?

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Ran away, you say? One believes we would all benefit from a more thorough retelling. Start from the beginning.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, okay. Paimon just hopes he won't mind...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Paimon tells Cloud Retainer everything she knows about Gaming's family situation...

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: ...What?

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: This shall not do!

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Lantern Rite fast approaches. We must make haste.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: As one was contacting various tailors around Liyue, one could not help but be reminded of Menogias.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: He possessed a singular talent for clothing design. He had an exquisite eye not just for fabric selection and color pairing, but also for what accessories could best accentuate a garment's overall styling.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: At a gathering of adepti, Bonanus once complained in secret to some of the ladies in attendance that the skirt Menogias made for her was too long and impractical, lamenting that it would only hinder her in battle.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: However, when one asked Menogias his opinion, he remarked that the train of the skirt would serve to enhance her adeptal countenance by exemplifying a certain elegance. Menogias was that type of person. When it came to topics relating to garments and accessories, not even Rex Lapis could best his stubbornness.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: And later...

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Ah, one seems to have strayed off-topic.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: One means to say that Lantern Rite should be a day of reunion.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: It is a time to address problems before they turn into regrets.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Fate is fickle. The cruel reality of this world is that suffering and misfortune can befall any of us without design or reason. If there is a chance for young people to remain insulated from this reality, one should do one's utmost to make it so.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's nice and all, but...

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Do you have any ideas, Cloud Retainer?

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Perhaps adeptal arts could be of use? No, no... mechanics, perhaps? Hmm, one fails to see its use in a situation such as this...

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: ...Is there anything I can do to help?

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Hmm...

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Combining our efforts... is a fine idea indeed.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Aha! One has an idea...

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: How about this...

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: ...Does that make sense to everyone?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yep! Paimon really hopes this works!

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Hmph, one's designs never fail.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Now then, I counsel rest for all, and to make the necessary preparations. One shall see you in two days...

dialogues.speaker: Shuyu
dialogues.text: Gaming, can I do the coloring?

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Sure! I'll go ahead and make the frame for you.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Once I get better at making kites, I'm going to make one shaped like Yuegui.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: You gave him to me, and he's just the best!

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Hehe... One is pleased that you like the gift.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: First, we have to decide on the shape... Hey, what are you laughing at?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The obvious answer is to make a Paimon-shaped kite.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, that's not a completely crazy idea.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If nothing else, a Paimon-shaped kite could at least make sure you never get lost on your travels and always find the tastiest food and funnest things to do wherever you go!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Maybe we're not exercising enough artistic license... We should exaggerate this a bit. How about this? The word "Paimon" means... "The Guardian Angel of Travelers"!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You build the kite's frame according to Cloud Retainer's instructions...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Now... what expression should we give her? Since the kite is going to be flying super high in the sky...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: She should look pleased with herself...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, like this? "Hahahaha! The title of champion kite-flyer is mine!"

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: She should look afraid...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "It's too high! Someone save Paimon! She's about to faint!" Like that?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: She should look guilty about something...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Ohh, Paimon totally didn't do anything wrong, and even if she did, she doesn't deserve to get shot up into the sky for it..." Something like this, then?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me rethink this...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Since the kite is going to be flying super high in the sky...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Phew... it's done! Paimon has to say, Kite-Paimon might even rival real Paimon in terms of cuteness.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Now we just have to attach the string, right?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Alright. Gather around, everyone.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh! Xianyun's calling us.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Let one take a look...

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Wow! Ganyu and Shenhe made a scissor-tailed swallow! It's so pretty!

dialogues.speaker: Shuyu
dialogues.text: Yep! The coloring... makes it look a lot like Master.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If the tail wasn't split in two like that, it might even be a spitting image!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If you look closely, there are a few spots where the colors go outside the lines... Did you doze off while painting it, Ganyu?

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: I did the painting.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: I stared at the paper for quite some time, but I simply could not recall the coloring of any bird... except Master.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Or should I say that I'm too familiar with her crane form? Even when she stands before us in human form, all I can see is blue and white.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh... Well, now that you mention it, Paimon can see it too...

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Exactly. So, I simply closed my eyes and painted from memory.

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: No way! You can paint with your eyes closed? Wow, the disciples of adepti really are something!

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: You are most filial, Shenhe. One is flattered by the likeness.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: The suanni that Gaming and Shuyu made looks very majestic. I'm sure it'll look even more impressive as it soars through the sky.

dialogues.speaker: Shuyu
dialogues.text: The eyes and ears glow in the dark, so you're sure to see it at night.

dialogues.speaker: Shuyu
dialogues.text: Your golden finch is cute too, Yaoyao!

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: It's all thanks to Aunty Cloud Retainer's guidance.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: #What about your kite, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Tada! Here it is!

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Its self-important countenance bears a striking resemblance to that of its namesake.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Hehe, it makes her look like she's already won the competition.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, that's gonna happen one way or another.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Hmph...

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Pfft, that's hilarious.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why does Paimon feel like you're laughing at her and not with her...

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: I'm just admiring the expression you chose. Whether the kite soars high in the air or comes crashing straight to the ground, it's still fitting.

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, that's quite the impressive feat, actually.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Very Paimon-like indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why do you say that, Shenhe?

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: #That one time {NICKNAME} suspected that a piece of meat was missing from their bowl, that was the exact expression on your face.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: I—Is that something that happened?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...So it was you.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Be careful, you two!

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Now for the string...

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: I hope the person who released the kite is going to be okay...

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Master is not without her principles... We need not worry too much.

dialogues.speaker: Shuyu
dialogues.text: Please look after Master for me.

dialogues.speaker: Jiehu
dialogues.text: *exhale*... It seems that one's concern was misplaced after all.

dialogues.speaker: Houzhang
dialogues.text: Then should we continue flying the kite?

dialogues.speaker: Jiehu
dialogues.text: A splendid suggestion! But it would be advisable to change locations.

dialogues.speaker: Houzhang
dialogues.text: Perhaps your mountain would suffice? It is more than spacious enough.

dialogues.speaker: Jiehu
dialogues.text: A fine idea... a fine idea indeed.
